title: cyclobalanus ovalis
intro: Cyclobalanus ovalis, commonly known as the Chinese holly tree, is a species of plant in the family Lauraceae. This plant is traditionally used in Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and promote digestive health. The therapeutic actions of Cyclobalanus ovalis include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce stress and anxiety, and improve overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, terpenoids, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
